description: This file contains JUnit test cases for the LocaleUtility class in the OpenMRS project, specifically testing locale compatibility, default locale retrieval, locale parsing from specifications, order and uniqueness of local lists, and session-dependent behaviors.

classes.name: LocaleUtilityTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing various functionalities of the LocaleUtility class in the OpenMRS project, including locale compatibility, parsing, ordering, and session-related behaviors.

methods.name: areCompatible_shouldConfirmMatchingLanguageAsCompatible
methods.description: Tests that locales with the same language are considered compatible by LocaleUtility.areCompatible.

methods.name: areCompatible_shouldNotConfirmDifferentLanguageAsCompatible
methods.description: Tests that locales with different languages are not considered compatible.

methods.name: areCompatible_shouldConfirmMatchingCountryAsCompatible
methods.description: Tests that locales with the same country are considered compatible.

methods.name: areCompatible_shouldNotConfirmDifferentCountryAsCompatible
methods.description: Tests that locales with different countries are not considered compatible.

methods.name: areCompatible_shouldConfirmSameLanguageMissingCountryAsCompatible
methods.description: Tests that locales with the same language but one missing country are compatible.

methods.name: areCompatible_shouldConfirmDifferentLanguageMissingCountryAsCompatible
methods.description: Tests that locales with different languages and missing country are not compatible.

methods.name: getDefaultLocale_shouldNotFailWithBogusGlobalPropertyValue
methods.description: Ensures getDefaultLocale does not fail when global property values are invalid or malformed.

methods.name: getDefaultLocale_shouldNotFailWithEmptyGlobalPropertyValue
methods.description: Ensures getDefaultLocale safely handles empty global property values.

methods.name: getDefaultLocale_shouldNotReturnNullIfGlobalPropertyDoesNotExist
methods.description: Verifies getDefaultLocale defaults appropriately when no global property exists.

methods.name: getDefaultLocale_shouldReturnLocaleObjectForGlobalProperty
methods.description: Checks that getDefaultLocale correctly returns a Locale based on the global property setting.

methods.name: fromSpecification_shouldGetLocaleFromTwoCharacterLanguageCode
methods.description: Tests parsing of locale from a simple language code.

methods.name: fromSpecification_shouldGetLocaleFromLanguageCodeAndCountryCode
methods.description: Tests parsing of locale from combined language and country code.

methods.name: fromSpecification_shouldGetLocaleFromBCP47Format
methods.description: Tests parsing from BCP47 formatted string.

methods.name: fromSpecification_shouldReturnNullWhenLocaleFormatIsIncorrectLocaleFromBCP47Format
methods.description: Verifies that parsing fails gracefully with incorrect format strings.

methods.name: fromSpecification_shouldGetLocaleFromLanguageCodeCountryCodeAndVariant
methods.description: Tests parsing including a variant in the locale string.

methods.name: getLocalesInOrder_shouldAlwaysHaveEnglishIncludedInTheReturnedCollection
methods.description: Ensures that the set of locales always includes English.

methods.name: getLocalesInOrder_shouldAlwaysHaveDefaultLocaleDefaultValueIncludedInTheReturnedCollection
methods.description: Checks inclusion of the default locale in the ordered set.

methods.name: getLocalesInOrder_shouldHaveDefaultLocaleAsTheFirstElementIfUserHasNoPreferredLocale
methods.description: Validates locale ordering when user has no preferred locale.

methods.name: getLocalesInOrder_shouldHaveDefaultLocaleAsTheSecondElementIfUserHasAPreferredLocale
methods.description: Checks that the user's preferred locale appears first, followed by the default locale.

methods.name: getLocalesInOrder_shouldReturnASetOfLocalesWithAPredictableOrder
methods.description: Verifies specific order of locales based on global properties.

methods.name: getLocalesInOrder_shouldReturnASetOfLocalesWithNoDuplicates
methods.description: Ensures the list of locales contains no duplicates even if global property has repeated entries.

methods.name: should_resetTheLocale
methods.description: Resets the user's locale to null and clears global property cache, used as a cleanup method.

methods.name: getDefaultLocale_shouldNotCacheLocaleWhenSessionIsNotOpen
methods.description: Tests that getDefaultLocale does not cache the locale across session boundaries.
